subject_line: The one food stalling your weight loss right now
opening: Happy Sunday, friends! This week we're talking about something that's quietly tripping up a lot of carnivore women over 50, and honestly, the answer might surprise you. Grab your coffee and keep reading because there's a lot worth digging into this week.

hero.title: Is Cheese Stalling Your Weight Loss After 50?
hero.teaser: You're eating carnivore, you're staying consistent, but the scale hasn't moved in weeks. Here's the thing most people don't consider: one totally carnivore-legal food might be the reason. Sarah walks through exactly why cheese behaves differently in women over 50, and she's got a simple test you can run this week to find out if it's yours. You don't have to cut it forever, but you do need to know the answer.

supporting.title: Hot Flashes on Carnivore: What Actually Changes
supporting.teaser: Sarah maps out what's actually happening week by week when night sweats start fading on carnivore, and the reason isn't what most people guess.

supporting.title: 80/20 or 93/7 Beef: Which Fits Your Macros
supporting.teaser: Marcus shows how one number on a package can shift your entire day's calories without you realizing it.

supporting.title: Knee Pain After 60: Carnivore and Arthritis
supporting.teaser: Sarah explains what carnivore actually can and can't do for your knees, and why month two tends to feel so different from month one.

try_this_week: Pull the cheese out for five days. Just five days. Keep everything else exactly the same and track how you feel on day three versus day one. Community members who've tried this often report a noticeable shift in bloating and energy before the week is even up.
looking_ahead: Next week we're getting into something Marcus has been testing quietly for months, and it changes how you think about meal timing on carnivore entirely.
